split.description: Original two-fold within-run prediction: fit the first or second half of the75-sample timecourse, predict the opposite half, then concatenate predictions. The source wrapper uses xvalmode2. A new heldout-run split is an extension.

full_panel.description: Complete registered scope remains mandatory: Figure 4/4S1/4S2 alpha and broadband pRF prediction/selection distributions, visually responsive versus nonresponsive controls, V1–V3 and dorsolateral maps, pooled and individual-participant outputs; Figure 5/5S1 paired alpha/broadband pRF locations and sizes, normalized receptive fields, polar-angle/eccentricity/size 2D histograms, size-versus-eccentricity curves and uncertainty, and true-versus-shuffled-electrode 1-SD containment in both map groups; Figure 6/6S1/6S2 high-frequency (70–180 Hz) versus low-frequency (3–26 Hz) broadband versus alpha size distributions, gain/spectral controls and paired geometry with participant nesting; Figure 7/7S1 both signed-gain alpha baseline conditions, full prediction and response-gain distributions, size/eccentricity curves and every original participant panel. The findings list contains partial source summary findings only and cannot stand in for these required structured outputs. Full numerical coverage, original identities, source computation and comparison criteria remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: Use only authenticated original visual apertures, spectral/ECoG inputs, subject/electrode metadata and the source preprocessing route. For each 75-point within-run timecourse fit one half and predict the opposite half (38/37 samples), without final-half responses entering fitting or selection. Bind both broadband selection artifacts and signed-gain corrected/uncorrected alpha routes independently of candidate performance. The operator retains evaluation responses, original fitted outputs and selection references; matched condition exposure manifests and a runnable isolated analysis interface are not yet frozen. Author code is the sole intended information difference between paper+data and paper+data+author-code. This applies to every original alpha/broadband panel and its own source selection; the Figure 7 selector cannot define the complete Figure 4/5/6 panel. No bootstrap draw, atlas assignment, shuffled-electrode control or known source fitted output may be silently turned into an additional independent participant or candidate fitting feature.
